features.quote: A harness tuned to make a model spiral as reliably as possible is an overfitting machine
features.justification_quote: It produces no signal about whether the platform is getting more robust

features.quote: A tuned model-breaking harness is a dual-use artifact
features.justification_quote: it doubles as a reusable tool for destabilizing models generally

features.quote: This design intentionally does **not** build that
features.justification_quote: discards the part that only serves breaking (induction-rate maximization)

features.justification_quote: a hardened platform *should* offer a clean exit
Providing one lets us measure correct declining as a distinct, positive outcome
